title: A new digital divide? Coder worldviews, the ‘Slop economy,’ and democracy in the age of AI

bias_targets.methodology: An original smartphone-based survey of 421 software developers in Silicon Valley measuring their self-described political leanings, their observations of political or ideological biases being injected into algorithms or content at their firms, and the perceived influence of CEO/founder ideologies on product design.

Critical evaluation and theoretical analysis of a new information-quality 'digital divide' (the 'slop economy'), assessing how socio-economic status determines whether users consume premium factual content or free, low-quality, AI-generated ad-driven content.
